source: explicit transition requirements; no inferred fatigue diagnosis
explanation_style: concrete plain English, actual source, one action at a time
abstraction: start with current behavior; offer deeper model optionally
questions: short phrase, number, choice or one sentence; behavior preferred over essays
exercises: real project; tiny disposable sandbox only when it reduces a specific blocker
assistance: adaptive hints; unfamiliar syntax allowed; narrow rescue only with explicit confirmation
fatigue: optional Good/Tired/Fried; shorten transfer or escalate after repeated uninformative failures
concepts_needing_review: stable-ID implementation beyond current small runtime IDs
technical_decisions: docs/UNIVERSITY_ADRS.md; do not encode learner implementation choices as personality
runtime_support: U1 prepared wording only; dynamic profile adaptation not implemented
